results.question: How many sales were made in 2023?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendas WHERE strftime('%Y', data_venda) = '2023'
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sales FROM vendas WHERE strftime('%Y', data_venda) = '2023'

results.question: What are the best-selling products by quantity?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.nome, SUM(iv.quantidade) AS total_quantidade
FROM itens_venda iv
JOIN produtos p ON iv.produto_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY total_quantidade DESC
LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.codigo_produto, p.nome, SUM(iv.quantidade) AS total_quantity FROM itens_venda iv JOIN produtos p ON iv.produto_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.codigo_produto, p.nome ORDER BY total_quantity DESC

results.question: Show a list of active customers
results.generated_sql: SELECT id, nome, email, telefone, cidade, estado FROM clientes WHERE ativo = 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM clientes WHERE ativo = 1

results.question: Revenue by month for 2023
results.generated_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', data_venda) AS mes, SUM(valor_total) AS receita
FROM vendas
WHERE strftime('%Y', data_venda) = '2023'
GROUP BY mes
ORDER BY mes
results.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', data_venda) AS month, SUM(valor_total) AS total_sales FROM vendas WHERE strftime('%Y', data_venda) = '2023' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

results.question: List active employees in the Finance department
results.generated_sql: SELECT id, nome, email, cargo, salario, data_admissao, telefone, endereco, supervisor_id FROM funcionarios WHERE ativo = 1 AND departamento = 'Financeiro'
results.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM funcionarios WHERE ativo = 1 AND departamento = 'Financeiro'

results.question: Show total sales per employee in 2023
results.generated_sql:
SELECT f.nome AS employee_name, SUM(v.valor_total) AS total_sales
FROM vendas v
JOIN funcionarios f ON v.funcionario_id = f.id
WHERE v.data_venda BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
GROUP BY f.id, f.nome
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
results.gold_sql: SELECT f.id, f.nome, COUNT(v.id) AS order_count, SUM(v.valor_total) AS revenue FROM funcionarios f LEFT JOIN vendas v ON v.funcionario_id = f.id AND strftime('%Y', v.data_venda) = '2023' GROUP BY f.id, f.nome ORDER BY order_count DESC

results.question: Count how many distinct products were sold in 2023
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT iv.produto_id) FROM itens_venda iv JOIN vendas v ON iv.venda_id = v.id WHERE strftime('%Y', v.data_venda) = '2023'
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT iv.produto_id) AS product_count FROM itens_venda iv JOIN vendas v ON iv.venda_id = v.id WHERE strftime('%Y', v.data_venda) = '2023'

results.question: Find the top 3 clients with the highest total order value
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.nome, SUM(v.valor_total) AS total_value FROM clientes c JOIN vendas v ON c.id = v.cliente_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 3
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.nome, SUM(v.valor_total) AS revenue FROM clientes c JOIN vendas v ON v.cliente_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nome ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: List all software products ordered by most expensive
results.generated_sql: SELECT nome, preco_venda FROM produtos WHERE categoria = 'Software' ORDER BY preco_venda DESC
results.gold_sql: SELECT * FROM produtos WHERE categoria = 'Software' ORDER BY preco_venda DESC

results.question: Which product categories had more than one distinct product sold?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.categoria
FROM itens_venda iv
JOIN produtos p ON iv.produto_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.categoria
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT p.categoria, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS products_sold FROM itens_venda iv JOIN produtos p ON iv.produto_id = p.id GROUP BY p.categoria HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 1
